title: 守护者双手
brief: Thin fitted moss cloth gloves, brown leather palms, five articulated fingers each, brass wrist seam, a cyan crystal ONLY on left hand BACK. Back/palm/grip views.
implementation_status: 已改手部材质底色、织物微纹与柔和边光；尚未完成概念级定制手模和蒙皮。
review_notes: 沿用 SDK 骨骼和显示层隔离；后续定制手套需单独完成蒙皮、掌纹 UV、握持穿插和双眼检查。概念以完整手套为主，其他图的露指变体不采用。

title: 教学演示手
brief: Anatomically connected translucent pale aqua hands. Three sequential views: left palm open facing down toward ground, right index approaches LEFT HAND BACK, right fingertip touches crystal on left hand BACK. Other right fingers curled. Visible contact pulse. No palm-to-palm pose. Labels OPEN, TOUCH, RELEASE.
implementation_status: 已增加教学手横截面细分并重叠关节端部；仍是程序化演示网格。
review_notes: 左手保持稳定，右手单独靠近；教学必须展示触点和分离后的空隙。不能把手掌接触、长按蓄力或捏合作为施法要求。

title: 手背水晶
brief: Small low profile faceted turquoise mana crystal in antique brass leaf-shaped bezel on moss glove. Exploded bezel and crystal, EMPTY HALF FULL views, wrist-to-knuckles fill, subtle etched water vein, no enormous floating gemstone.
implementation_status: 已增加叶形托座、晶体边光和水位分界光；填充逻辑保留。
review_notes: 托座厚度不能干扰实际触点。满、半、空在掌心转向和不同肤色背景下均须可读；隐藏或追踪丢失时遵守原有显示策略。

title: 雪松
brief: Stylized miniature cedar with tapering bark trunk, roots, seven irregular drooping layered boughs, visible gaps and branch tips. Tall narrow, broad and leaning variants. Close bark and foliage details. Forest green sunlit tips, no perfect stacked cones.
implementation_status: 已调整树冠层次、轻微偏斜和枝梢；包含在 9 件环境模型重建中。
review_notes: 保留 Trunk / Canopy 语义分组；不同观察角度树冠闭合，不以透明叶片堆叠增加过绘。图中宣传字样不代表性能验证。

title: 阔叶树
brief: Stylized miniature broadleaf tree, visible forked trunk, asymmetric irregular leafy clusters of varied scale, broad flattened crown, gaps, drooping twigs and fresh shoots. Three variants, leaf/bark details. No spherical lollipop silhouette.
implementation_status: 已重建分叉树干、根部、11 组叶簇与叶片轮廓。
review_notes: 轮廓从正面、侧面、俯视均须有层次。树根落地，树冠体积不侵入相邻瞄准通道。

title: 蕨类
brief: Handcrafted forest ferns, curled fiddleheads and mature curved fronds with readable separated leaflets; three sizes, clump composition, moss green and yellow green tips. Rooted at ground.
implementation_status: 已增加卷芽和叶端细节。
review_notes: 低矮地被放在边缘和建筑脚下，不覆盖脚下溪流和目标圈；用实体低模叶片。

title: 草丛与野花
brief: Five small modular meadow clumps: coarse blades, sparse cream flowers, clover, dry grass, moss cushions. Broad readable stylized shapes, ground contacts, arrangement near tree roots, no dense photoreal grass.
implementation_status: 已在岛屿外围加入花簇；草丛独立套件尚待精修。
review_notes: 中心救援路径保持低密度；边缘用稀疏簇状分布，远景合并为色块。

title: 岩石
brief: Rounded fractured slate and warm limestone stones, three sizes, broad planes, moss on upper ledges, damp dark base and dry version, stable flat contact bases, small bank assembly.
implementation_status: 已加入少量苔藓块并统一环境材质高光。
review_notes: 岩石与地面应接触，底面封闭；同一资产通过旋转和缩放复用，避免明显重复。

title: 倒木
brief: Fallen forest log, bark plates, exposed end rings, broken side branch, moss along top, two variants and end section. Rounded stylized warm timber. Real supporting ground contact.
implementation_status: 已补苔藓和枝条；最后修正了苔藓高度。
review_notes: 端面封口，树皮与年轮不共面闪烁；少量大裂纹优先于细密雕花。

title: 微缩岛屿
brief: Oblong forest tabletop island with readable layered soil and rock sidewall, moss meadow, patchy bare earth, path and a near-front crosswise creek. Quiet flat central lanes reserved for gameplay; decoration concentrated perimeter. Isometric whole island, side cross-section, top layout.
implementation_status: 已增加边缘花簇与近岸小石；未改变玩法区域尺寸。
review_notes: 前方 z<1.6 留出平坦操作区域，树木主通道 z3..10；新增细节限于外围和河岸。

title: 溪流与河岸
brief: Narrow shallow miniature creek flowing between wet banks, visible pebbles and shallow sand, soft turquoise water, broken foam along rock contacts, ripples and damp edge gradient. Cross section plus close flowing surface. NO waterfall.
implementation_status: 已细化邻岸小石；溪水主体沿用已有着色与流动系统。
review_notes: 保持前侧溪流中心约 z2.1；所有水流源头必须连接实体。概念中的附加瀑布不属于此次新增内容。

title: 林间木屋
brief: Cozy tiny rescue cabin: individually shaped planks, clay tile roof with thick eaves, framed cream glowing windows, brass handle, stone foundation, chimney and restrained woodpile. Front back views and wet/scorched material samples.
implementation_status: 已增加外露梁柱、窗沿、金属钉和小木堆。
review_notes: 不移动木屋玩法位置、健康显示或命中区域；门窗与屋顶交接必须封闭。

title: 储水罐与喷淋器
brief: Miniature blue enamel pressure tank on sturdy braced stand, brass pipes, large readable water gauge, rotating sprinkler crossbar, footing. Filled and spraying states. Clear functional connections.
implementation_status: 已增加铜箍、支座和水位窗两侧装饰；原始充水和喷淋逻辑保持。
review_notes: 装饰不得覆盖水位窗或旋转轴；喷头连接罐体，水从真实喷淋位置发出。

title: 压杆补水站
brief: Forest rescue hand-operated well pump, deep teal enamel body, cream wood lever handle, antique brass joints, cyan refill coupling, readable water gauge. Pump lever raised and lowered views, grounded base, accessible hand clearance.
implementation_status: 已给三种补水站共用底座加细节，并替换部分硬边方块网格。
review_notes: 图是外观目标，不能据图改变补水对接口、握持锚点或压杆运动方向。

title: 阀轮补水站
brief: Same rescue equipment family: deep teal hydrant with rounded body, antique brass fittings, cyan wheel grip and refill port, sturdy slate base. Front/side, wheel turning demonstration and water-flow lamp. No text clutter.
implementation_status: 共用材质和底座已细化；完整阀轮重建尚未完成。
review_notes: 阀轮碰撞、操作区域和原有旋转阈值保留；轮辐不能遮住手部。

title: 按钮补水站
brief: Same rescue equipment family: compact rounded teal water dispenser, shallow wood canopy, one large ivory/cyan push button with travel, brass refill coupling and flow gauge. Idle and pressed state, practical tabletop VR hand access.
implementation_status: 共用底座与部分圆角外壳已细化。
review_notes: 保留按钮实际接触点和可按压范围，装饰不能被误认为第二个按钮。

title: 溪流取水器
brief: Compact teal portable creek pump with brass handle pivots, blue intake hose, finely structured brass strainer, slate mounting pad. Isometric, intake detail, wet material. Kept low and functional.
implementation_status: 已细化现有 FBX 的少量金属件；未重新启用该设备。
review_notes: 该项保留为现有历史/备用素材的美术方向，不恢复旧玩法或替换当前补水站。

title: 工具架
brief: Warm timber and dark green metal rescue tool stand, four shaped padded tool slots, brass edging, cyan refill markers, clearly visible empty slot contours, rounded safe edges. Empty and loaded layout, no floating tools.
implementation_status: 已在现有底座加入三块木板、护边和后侧支撑。
review_notes: 当前生产逻辑为单个装备展示位和切换控件；概念四槽仅用于收纳风格参考，不直接扩成四个交互槽。

title: 救援小羊
brief: Appealing small cream wool sheep, cocoa face, expressive eyes, pink ear interiors, rounded dark hooves, asymmetrical soft wool clusters. Front side back, idle happy scared wet and held poses; wholesome, no injuries. Small pink affection heart.
implementation_status: 已增加 7 个稀疏小毛簇；现有运动、表情与声音逻辑保留。
review_notes: 不得以长毛透明片遮挡眼睛；抱起与抚摸的接触范围保持。概念更精细的表情属于后续目标。

title: 天空与远山
brief: Stylized miniature forest sky backdrop with pale blue to mint gradient, sculpted cream cumulus tops and cool undersides, layered sage hills, subtle warm sun direction. Three calm lighting variations, keep center clear; concept background no realistic photo.
implementation_status: 本轮未继续改动天空；沿用工作区已有实现，概念待评审。
review_notes: 保留目前局部天空覆盖与透明背景策略；不把 MR 背景强行改成全景封闭天空。

title: 救援营地
brief: Cozy miniature forest rescue camp: wooden sign board, small cabin, teal water equipment, timber tool stand, moss ground and rocks, gently glowing lantern. Clear central player approach and readable paths. Isometric and eye-level composition.
implementation_status: 共享树木与材质可复用到营地；未完成营地布局重做。
review_notes: 概念中的额外陈设只用于气氛，不增加玩法；真正陈设需复用本清单装备，避免网兜等无关道具。

title: 泡沫灭火器
brief: Red enamel extinguisher, rounded tank shoulder, brass connectors, rubber hose with separate cyan aiming nozzle, gold rear carry handle, movable squeeze lever with finger clearance, cream instruction panel, readable pressure gauge. Hero and reverse side, grip and nozzle details.
implementation_status: 已增加罐体铜箍、标签线条、握区细节和表盘圈。
review_notes: 喷口位置、主副握点、喷射方向均保留。说明牌采用可读大图形，避免微小文字。

title: 脉冲水枪
brief: Compact blue enamel rescue water pistol, rounded receiver, dark rubber ergonomic grip, brass fittings, small cyan water window, crisp single nozzle. Side and front views plus three discrete pulsed water packets. Friendly tool not military weapon.
implementation_status: 已增加侧板、金属条、握把纹理、罐口及表盘装饰。
review_notes: 握持、喷口、补水接口不移动；概念中的额外安全锁只作造型，不能变成新操作。

title: 扇形喷水器
brief: Green enamel rescue spray tool, wide five-outlet manifold, brass distribution pipes, black soft grip, cream tank label. Five visible water streams forming a fan, side/face view, readable mechanical assembly. Friendly rescue equipment.
implementation_status: 已应用装备共用圆角与装饰；完整歧管造型尚待进一步精修。
review_notes: 保持原有覆盖范围与出水数量，不能因概念的宽喷流提高实际伤害/灭火范围。

title: 蓄压水炮
brief: Orange enamel compact water cannon with thick rounded pressure chamber, brass protective hoops, side cyan pull handle, dark support grip and five clear pressure cells. Charged and released states with a rounded water bomb and splash. Friendly rescue equipment.
implementation_status: 已增加较宽侧板和共用装饰；复杂皮革与雕刻仍为概念目标。
review_notes: 保持侧向拉柄、辅助手和压力阈值；不能用视觉延迟改变发射时机。

title: 完整水系魔法
brief: Production VFX storyboard with six spacious sequential panels: cyan crystal filling on LEFT HAND BACK, left open palm aiming at ground ripple, right fingertip touching left hand BACK, clear aqua water stream with subtle spiral filaments from left PALM, splash on burning tiny tree, fading steam and dim crystal. Cozy forest magic, practical restrained effects, no huge runes blocking view.
implementation_status: 已加入施法时掌侧光环和目标波纹，改善引导光点路径；完整水带及水冠仍待制作。
review_notes: 视觉范围对应 Run.MagicRadius；不能让水带遮住手指、火焰或小羊。保持左右眼一致，不做全屏折射。

title: 火焰与余烬
brief: One stylized cedar across four stages HEALTHY HEATING BURNING COOLED. Asymmetric readable orange fire tongues hugging real branches, a few drifting embers, darkened wet bark after extinguishing. Separate tiny flame shape breakdown. No giant explosion.
implementation_status: 本轮未重写火焰系统；已完成独立效果概念与状态规范。
review_notes: 火焰必须附着燃烧目标，熄灭后停发；保持现有软叠加风格，避免硬三角片和过亮白团。

title: 烟与蒸汽
brief: VFX design sheet contrasting slow warm grey smoke from burning wood with short pale cyan steam puffs from water impact. Three lifecycle frames each, soft broken silhouettes and low opacity, readable tree underneath, no opaque wall of fog.
implementation_status: 概念完成；运行时沿用原有有界粒子系统。
review_notes: 不得持续盖住树冠和瞄准圈；强度上限、粒子总量优先沿用现有设置。图中水桶不是新增装备。

title: 水流与飞溅
brief: VFX sheet of coherent turquoise water stream with bright thin crest, spaced pulse droplets, five-stream fan, water-bomb impact crown; contact ripples on soil and bark. Each isolated on muted forest green swatch, no overwhelming glow.
implementation_status: 完整效果概念完成；本轮主要落地的是魔法引导与涟漪。
review_notes: 不通过增加巨量透明粒子换取密度；复用网格水线与现有粒子，保留弹道和湿润计算。

title: 泡沫
brief: Soft cream-white extinguishing foam stream with large readable clustered bubbles, impact spreading on a small scorched log, thinning residue after cooling. Three lifecycle frames and nozzle closeup, restrained airy mist, no snow avalanche.
implementation_status: 概念完成；泡沫专用形状和残留图集尚待制作。
review_notes: 泡沫应服从现有命中与覆盖范围，不能形成遮挡目标的大白墙。

title: 救援与奖励
brief: Cute cream sheep sequential rescue vignette: frightened beside small burning tree, wet protected sheep, running toward refuge, happy hop with one gold coin, petting with small pink heart. Separate simple coin/heart details. Clear understated effects.
implementation_status: 概念完成；现有奖励/爱心表现保持，小羊毛簇已细化。
review_notes: 不增加额外任务或奖励数值；一枚金币是视觉符号，不代表每次固定只加一金币。

title: 风与光尘
brief: Forest miniature atmosphere concept: leaf tips and grass bending gently, sparse warm dust in localized sunlit patch, a few loose leaves, very faint short breeze accents above grove. Scene unobscured, no giant white streaks, no fog wall.
implementation_status: 已缩短风线并降低透明度与摆幅；光尘数量未提高。
review_notes: 不使用满屏长白线或密集闪点；最大三角面仍遵守环境特效既有预算。

title: 营地主菜单
brief: VR forest rescue main menu concept: refined warm wood framed dark forest green board, ample spacing, cream readable text, restrained brass leaf corners. Exact English labels EMBERDEEP, CONTINUE, NEW GAME, SETTINGS, QUIT. Cozy camp context plus frontal board detail, believable handcrafted UI.
implementation_status: 已细化共享牌面材质；完整立体木框与标志尚待落地。
review_notes: 图中文字只是排版占位，正式菜单使用现有本地化与命令。退出流程、重开确认等保持。

title: 准备与倒计时
brief: VR miniature rescue preparation interface, compact forest green wood-framed board above island without covering it. Labels SECTOR 1, GUARDIAN HAND, 1 FIRE, 3 SHEEP, START, SHOP. Separate small elegant countdown 3 2 1 in three state thumbnails. Large legible spacing.
implementation_status: 共享牌面材质已更新；布局和流程未改。
review_notes: 保留当前准备/暂停/重试流程；图中手势缩略仅为风格参考，操作以第 02 项文字为准。

title: 战斗状态与瞄准
brief: Minimal VR firefighting combat HUD concept, small readable dark green status plaques leaving forest visible. Labels WATER, MANA, SHEEP; water-drop icon, sheep icon, clear meters; thin ground ripple ring centered on real target and subtle hand pointer. Forest action visible.
implementation_status: 共享界面材质与魔法目标涟漪已更新；HUD 重排未实施。
review_notes: 图中的粗金属大环仅是组件风格稿，实际瞄准环应细且半透明；任务文字沿用当前内容。

title: 装备与魔法商店
brief: Beautiful VR rescue shop board, dark forest green and warm wood, large isolated red extinguisher physical preview on right, simple upgrade comparison on left, cyan water and gold purchase accents. Exact labels MAGIC, TOOLS, STATION, UPGRADE, BUY, BACK. Focused readable layout.
implementation_status: 新增装饰已进入装备预览；修正预览网格/材质所有权，防止暂存对象销毁后细节丢失。
review_notes: 价格使用当前经济系统，图中货币和数值是占位。保留真实装备构建与显示对象隔离。

title: 操作教学
brief: Compact VR tutorial card, dark green wood frame, large connected translucent hand model demonstrating right index touching BACK of left glove with cyan gem, small contact ring. Exact labels OPEN LEFT HAND, TOUCH ITS BACK, LIFT TO STOP. Three clear sequential panels, generous whitespace.
implementation_status: 教学手网格与共享面板已开始细化；完整卡片重排未实施。
review_notes: 该图只定卡片风格；图旁独立水晶不代表实物位置。实际水晶必须附在左手手背，按第 03 项执行。

title: 结算与关卡成长
brief: Forest rescue success board with warm wood dark green cream typography, subtle gold leaf motif. Exact labels FOREST SAFE, SHEEP RESCUED, REWARD, RETRY, NEXT SECTOR. Tiny happy sheep foreground, wet cooling forest behind, restrained celebration. Include smaller failed state label TRY AGAIN without distress.
implementation_status: 概念完成；共享牌面材质可复用，结算结构未重做。
review_notes: 保留现有奖励、进度和重试逻辑；概念的水晶奖励及背景瀑布不作为新增功能。

title: 八关场景变化
brief: Eight distinct labeled miniature forest level thumbnails numbered 1 to 8, consistent oblong island near-front creek, left water station and right tool stand. Levels 1-3 serene magic clearings with 1 then 3 then 5 principal trees; 4-5 rescue grove with cabin; 6-8 progressively denser forest and scorch patches. Keep clear paths for sheep, warm cozy stylization, same layout footprint. No waterfalls.
implementation_status: 共享环境模型已重建；未新增八套布局或改变关卡参数。
review_notes: 实际树数为 1 / 3 / 5 / 3 / 9 / 18 / 30 / 42。前三关魔法教学，第 4 关开始设备；图中缩略数量与设备摆放不作数据依据。
